name: VeraCastell Services
address: 1210 Washington Ave Ste 200, Miami Beach, FL 33139, United States
website_note: veracastell.com esta registrado desde 2009 (RDAP activo, nameservers worldnic.com) y aparece impreso en los uniformes del equipo, pero responde 200 con una pagina de error generica de hosting ('Error. Page cannot be displayed. Please contact your service provider') sin contenido real. La ficha de Google Business del negocio muestra 'Add website' (sin boton de website propio). Se trata como dominio roto / sin sitio funcional, no como website propio activo.
service_mentions_google: attention to detail, mentioned in 4 reviews

reviewSamples.author: Josh Kravitz
reviewSamples.text: We hired Mr. Vera to to do cleaning, plumbing, and carpeting work at our condo after we moved out and his team did fast, efficient, and impressive work. We're too embarrassed to show the 'before' photos but you can see some 'after' photos

reviewSamples.author: Scott Russell
reviewSamples.text: Henry and his team are simply the best. They have the best dedicated girls who know how to properly clean. They use the best cleaning tools and cleaning products. I have used for general cleaning, carpet cleaning and window cleaning.

reviewSamples.author: Erinn King
reviewSamples.text: Above and Beyond! VeraCastell is client service at its finest. The attention to detail,

reviewSamples.author: Jackie Barba
reviewSamples.text: Henry & his team have been great to work with! They are quick to respond and schedule all painting jobs I have needed. Their work is clean and neat and I will definitely continue to work with & recommend their services. Great company :)

reviewSamples.author: Roberto Rosenfeld
reviewSamples.text: I live with my son and a cat. And I really can't tell which one creates more dirt! Fact is, our little condo was in great need of some deep cleaning so I called Veracastell services.

language_note: Las 5 resenas verbatim encontradas estan en ingles (autores Josh Kravitz, Scott Russell, Erinn King, Jackie Barba, Roberto Rosenfeld). Sin presencia de IG/FB para contrastar idioma de posts. Idioma principal: en.
